lean.name: Formalism.HC.Level.wt
lean.note: The distinguished character has weight one. The other weights are reciprocals of three times the level parameter plus one.
lean.fidelity_note: The weight in (4.2) is one for the distinguished character and the reciprocal of three times the level parameter plus one otherwise.

lean.name: Formalism.HC.Level.Gm
lean.plain: The weighted prime sum for a level
lean.note: The weighted sum adds the trivial character contribution separately.
lean.fidelity_note: This is the sum in (4.2). It starts with the trivial-character term and adds weighted real parts over the other kept characters.

lean.name: Formalism.HC.zeroFreeOn_of_levels
lean.plain: Combine the zero-free regions of the levels
lean.note: This combines levels already shown zero-free. Each requested primitive character inherits zero-freeness from a level that contains it. To obtain zero-freeness for an individual character, the proof chooses a zero-free level that contains it.
